name: Passing Bell

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The passing bell makes two Withering Touch attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Tolling Doom.

Actions.name: Withering Touch
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. 19 (3d10 + 3) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Tolling Doom
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 13, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage.
Actions.expresses: tolling the bell for the dying

Actions.name: Horrific Visage
Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Cone that can see the passing bell and isn't an Undead. *Failure:*  10 (2d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the passing bell's next turn. *Success:*  The target is immune to this ghost's Horrific Visage for 24 hours.

Actions.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
Actions.text:
*Charisma Saving Throw*: DC 13, one Humanoid the passing bell can see within 5 feet. *Failure:*  The target is possessed by the passing bell; the passing bell disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The passing bell now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The passing bell can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The passing bell's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's Speed, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers.
The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the passing bell leaves as a Bonus Action. When the possession ends, the passing bell appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours. *Success:*  The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours.

Actions.name: Etherealness
Actions.text: The passing bell casts the *Etherealness* spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. The passing bell is visible on the Material Plane while on the Border Ethereal and vice versa, but it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

Traits.name: Ethereal Sight
Traits.text: The passing bell can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane.

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The passing bell can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

lore: A bell-ringer who died at the rope mid-toll, still ringing for every soul that passes, and it rings now only for those whose last hour it can hear.

generation.userConcept: a chapel bell-ringer's ghost that tolls for the dying
generation.cite: composition after Doppelganger (CR 3) — the first-round-advantage opener

immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
resistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, Thunder
monsterDescription: a chapel bell-ringer's ghost that tolls for the dying
